title: add_slides
description: Insert several new slides at once, one per item, in order (a slide for each point of an outline).

items.description: One slide: what it says, and its layout when you choose it.

points.description: Its points, in order: short lines in your words, or {heading, text} (a column, a phase).

sources.description: Titles of the KB documents it comes from (cited in the notes).

layout.description: Left out: the one its content fits.
For every slide that names none. Left out: each the one it fits.

after_slide_id.description: Put them after this slide (its number or ID). Left out: at the end.
